title: Oven Roasted Spanish Asparagus Tortilla Espanola
description: A dense and comforting Spanish dish featuring asparagus, render fat, and a pescatarian friendly twist on the traditional tortilla espanola, cooked to perfection in a kazan cauldron.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large kazan cauldron, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the diced potatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the asparagus and cook until it is tender, about 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked potato and asparagus mixture to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture into the kazan cauldron and cook over medium heat until the edges start to set.
Transfer the kazan cauldron to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes, or until the tortilla is set and golden brown.
Remove the kazan cauldron from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
